description: Source code for a firmware image processing utility, including functions for calculating CRCs, processing images, and command-line interface handling for generating factory or sysupgrade flash images.

methods.name: calc_crc
methods.description: Calculates CRC checksums for the image header and payload, updating the header fields accordingly.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage information for the command-line utility.

methods.name: process_image
methods.description: Processes a firmware image file, modifying headers, calculating checksums, and adjusting image size for flashing.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point for the utility, handling command-line arguments and invoking image processing functions.
